namespace = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events

kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001 = {
    type = character_event

	trigger = {
		exists = scope:province
		exists = scope:culture
		scope:culture != root.culture
	}

	title = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:talent_acquisition }
				desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.t.unclear
			}
			desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.t
		}
	}
	
	desc = {
		desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.desc
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:gift }
				desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.desc.gift
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:gold_gift }
				desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.desc.gold_gift
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:impressive_character }
				desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.desc.impressive_character
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:talent_acquisition }
				desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.desc.talent_acquisition
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:provinces_modifier }
				desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.desc.province_modifier
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:character_modifier }
				desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.desc.character_modifier
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:maa_refill_gift }
				desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.desc.maa_refill_gift
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:esteemed_hospitality }
				desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.desc.esteemed_hospitality
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:gold_loot }
				desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.desc.gold_loot
			}
		}
	}

	theme = cultural_festival

	override_background = {
		trigger = { exists = scope:background_terrain_scope }
		reference = terrain_scope
	}

	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:introduced_character
		trigger = { exists = scope:introduced_character }
		animation = throne_room_bow_1
	}

	center_portrait = {
		character = scope:introduced_character_2
		trigger = { exists = scope:introduced_character_2 }
	}

	lower_left_portrait = {
		character = scope:introduced_character_3
		trigger = { exists = scope:introduced_character_3 }
	}

	right_portrait = {
		character = root
		animation = personality_rational
	}

	artifact = {
		target = scope:newly_created_artifact
		position = lower_center_portrait
		trigger = { exists = scope:newly_created_artifact }
	}

	immediate = {
		scope:province ?= {
			save_scope_as = background_terrain_scope # background illustration
			save_scope_as = location # used by character creation effects
		}

		clear_saved_scope = boon_type
		hidden_effect = { E_kCAFG_apply_random_cultural_boon = yes }

		#set_variable = { name = kCAFG_tmp_display value = scope:boon_type }
        #debug_log = "kCAFG - Cultural Benefits - Triggered for [THIS.Char.GetNameNoTooltip] with culture [culture.GetNameNoTooltip] in province [province.GetNameNoTooltip] with boon type [THIS.Var('kCAFG_tmp_display').GetFlagName]"

		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:impressive_character }
				add_courtier = scope:impressive_character
			}
		}
	}

    option = {
		name = {
			text = {
				first_valid = {
					triggered_desc = {
						trigger = {
							exists = scope:boon_type
							OR = {
								scope:boon_type = flag:gift
								scope:boon_type = flag:gold_gift
								scope:boon_type = flag:gold_loot
							}
						}
						desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.a.gift
					}
					triggered_desc = {
						trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:impressive_character }
						desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.a.impressive_character
					}
					triggered_desc = {
						trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:talent_acquisition }
						desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.a.talent_acquisition
					}
					triggered_desc = {
						trigger = { exists = scope:boon_type scope:boon_type = flag:esteemed_hospitality }
						desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.a.esteemed_hospitality
					}
					desc = kCAFG_cultural_benefits_events.0001.a
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:boon_type }

			switch = {
				trigger = scope:boon_type
				flag:gold_gift = { show_as_tooltip = { add_gold = scope:gold_amount } }
				flag:maa_refill_gift = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = scope:maa_refilled }
						show_as_tooltip = { custom_tooltip = E_kCAFG_cultural_boon_tradition_maa_refill_tt }
					}

					if = {
						limit = { exists = scope:maa_gifted }
						show_as_tooltip = { custom_tooltip = E_kCAFG_cultural_boon_tradition_maa_gift_tt }
					}
				}
				flag:character_modifier = {
					show_as_tooltip = { custom_tooltip = E_kCAFG_cultural_boon_character_modifier_tt }
				}
				flag:provinces_modifier = {
					show_as_tooltip = {
						every_in_list = {
							list = affected_provinces
							custom_tooltip = E_kCAFG_cultural_boon_province_modifier_tt
						}
					}
				}
				flag:counties_modifier = {
					show_as_tooltip = {
						every_in_list = {
							list = affected_counties
							custom_tooltip = E_kCAFG_cultural_boon_county_modifier_tt
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:newly_created_artifact }
			show_as_tooltip = { custom_tooltip = gain_artifact_tt }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:boon_type
				scope:boon_type = flag:esteemed_hospitality
				exists = scope:introduced_character
				exists = scope:introduced_character_2
				exists = scope:introduced_character_3
			}
			show_as_tooltip = {
				add_courtier = scope:introduced_character
				add_courtier = scope:introduced_character_2
				add_courtier = scope:introduced_character_3
			}
		}
    }
}
